Table header row.
content.field_unmarked: a tags-named multiselect with no taxonomy true field leaves the tag index empty.
content.field_behavior_failed: a throwing behavior.validate is treated as valid, so the bad value lands.
media.resolver_absent: a route factory built with media but no resolveMedia leaves media tokens literal.
admin.action.unaudited: dev throws and production logs when a createAdminAction route skips ctx.audit.
audit.sink.call_failed: the site's own sink threw or rejected, losing only the record.
rate_limit_absent and rate_limit_failed both degrade to open on purpose.
admin.action.misconfigured: resolveDb returned nothing or the access map was never attached.
config.invalid: loads degrade to empty and saves answer 500 while the log carries the parser message.
A symptom with no matching event is not code-fixable in advance; check troubleshooting or file it.
